title: Alert
description: Severity carried by rule weight rather than by hue, for a language with no accent colour

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading above the alert body.

props.name: severity
props.description: Rule and text emphasis; defaults to note. Does not assign an alert role.

props.name: inverted
props.description: Use the inverted surface treatment; defaults to false.

props.name: children
props.description: Content inside the alert body. Add role="alert" explicitly when an incoming message should interrupt the reader.
